summary: Round 3 is a valid comparison: before 12/100 versus installed 19/100 corrected wins. The favorable difference remains inconclusive, including cumulatively. Continue the fixed schedule without changing decks or repeating trials.
findings: Read AGENTS.md, the C17 brief, manifest, batch, prior JSON/Markdown reviews, runner and supervisor validation logic. Analyzed both summaries, all 200 game logs, 200 original stdout files and 200 parsed hand streams. Neither run has INVALID.txt or ABORTED.txt. No simulations, file modifications, purchases or engine changes were performed.

Controls verified: both locked source deck SHA256 values match the manifest; Forge-loaded copies match except Name. All frozen runtime files and all five opponent-group/schedule hashes match. Both round-3 trials.json files are byte-identical to trials-b3.json. All 100 summary trial IDs, pods, cases and seeds match the schedule; all logs identify the scheduled opponents in their prescribed seats.

Both summaries record classesSha 601627412546ce7c, cardsSha 02c2b0e93031edd8 and the correct respective deck hashes. Independently recomputed class fingerprint matches. Runner SHA256 remains ae37d38643cc55746f97064cfc26270f9c52d9c1ae52efe33b420521088d3d27. Recorded flags and execution code use SMART_AI/POLITICS with additional listed tactics/full-state flags cleared. Each trial is a separate process using its scheduled seed; PodSim initializes RNG with seed + 1. These verify artifacts and execution code, not independent per-process cryptographic attestations.

Before has 12 raw/corrected wins, 100 clean finishes and no suspects. Installed has 21 raw wins, 19 corrected wins, 98 clean finishes and two suspects counted as scheduled draws. Both report zero external timeout kills. Independent winner/conflict/duration checks reproduce the summary scoring. Clean-only rates are 12/100=12.0% versus 19/98=19.4%; corrected/all-start nominal Wilson 95% intervals are 7.0–19.8% versus 12.5–27.8%.

Genuine internal timeout: installed b3pod19-c5, seed 43319000, reports 600010 ms. Its original stdout explicitly says 'Stopping slow match as draw' after repeated invalid Impulsive Pilferer attack declarations. Its log declares all four players winners. The synthetic player-1 win is excluded; this is not an ordinary simulated finish. No external timeout JSON exists because Forge returned before the runner killed it.

Distinct duration suspect: installed b3pod07-c3, seed 23307000, reports 904286 ms, one consistent winner and a combat ending; original stdout contains no slow-match draw message and no external timeout marker exists. File birth/modification timestamps span approximately 909 seconds for stdout and 904 seconds for the hand stream. Read-only pmset power logs record approximately 838 seconds of overlapping system sleep, leaving approximately 66 seconds outside those recorded sleep intervals. This reconciles the elapsed-duration anomaly without inventing a timeout. It remains excluded under the predeclared >=600000-ms suspect rule; do not restore its win or call it a synthetic timeout. The runner does not provide a strict elapsed-time guarantee across system sleep, and exact active execution time is unavailable.

Round-3 shared clean pairing contains 98 trials: both win 3, installed-only wins 16, before-only wins 9, neither wins 70. Thus before wins 12/98 and installed 19/98. Paired difference +7.14 percentage points; nominal approximate 95% interval −2.76 to +17.04 points; exact two-sided McNemar p=0.2295. Pod dependence, AI timing, sleep-related censoring and repeated interim inspection limit nominal inference. Neither improvement nor equality is established.

Cumulative results retain group distinctions: b1 corrected 25/100 versus 26/100, raw 27 versus 28, suspects 2 versus 3; b2 corrected/raw 18/100 versus 26/100, suspects 1 versus 0; b3 corrected 12/100 versus 19/100, raw 12 versus 21, suspects 0 versus 2. Through three groups, corrected totals are 55/300=18.3% versus 71/300=23.7%; raw totals 57 versus 75; suspects 3 versus 5. Clean-only totals are 55/297=18.5% versus 71/295=24.1%. Groups b4–b5 are outside this review.

Across 294 cumulative shared clean trials: both win 23, installed-only 48, before-only 32, neither 191. Paired difference +5.44 points, nominal approximate 95% interval −0.49 to +11.37 points; exact McNemar p=0.0929. This remains inconclusive and is not grounds to repeat seeds or change the locked comparison.

Commander observations in each arm's clean games: before cast T'Challa in 95/100 games, with 153 cast events and 39 games containing recasts; installed in 96/98 games, with 145 events and 32 recast games. Median first cast was personal turn 4 in both arms. Recorded original-commander attack declarations were 210 versus 223; player combat damage totaled 951 versus 1118; blocker assignments against him were 68 versus 55; battlefield departures were 89 versus 97. These descriptive counts do not demonstrate improved survival or measure continuous survival duration.

Clean logs record 370 versus 384 resolutions of T'Challa's tapped-Vibranium creation description. Installed records 67 Mystic Forge activation declarations and five Nettlecyst equip declarations. These demonstrate artifact activity, not exact token inventories, available mana or causal value.

Added-card hand-exposure/cast-game counts across 98 clean installed games: Foundry Inspector 27/22; Clever Concealment 22/4; Path to Exile 31/26; Akroma's Will 25/21; Bronze Guardian 25/16; Mystic Forge 31/18; Winds of Abandon 31/20; Wurmcoil Engine 29/19; Nettlecyst 24/14; Forsaken Monument 25/20; Thousand Moons Smithy 25/13. Exposure includes opening/mulligan hands and does not necessarily represent a retained draw. All additions were cast. Low casting frequency does not establish stranding or weakness. Local scripts retain AI:RemoveDeck:Random for Mystic Forge; the other additions have no analogous AI flag.

Concrete case 1: installed b3pod14-c2 created Nettlecyst's Germ and cast Mystic Forge. T'Challa connected for 4, then attacked into Tom, Bert, and William: he dealt 4 to the blocker, took 5 and died. Nettlecyst later equipped Metalwork Colossus and Panther Robot. Akroma's Will resolved its flying/vigilance/double-strike mode while T'Challa was absent; he was subsequently recast, grew through artifact casts and connected for 6 during the final attack. Installed won in 52769 ms; before lost in 22093 ms. This shows useful equipment/artifact development alongside a costly commander attack, without isolating any card as the cause of the paired win.

Concrete case 2: installed b3pod07-c5 recorded T'Challa player hits of 7, 9, 11, 13 and 15 as artifact casts grew him. Terisiare's Devastation later resolved its artifact-scaled negative-toughness effect and T'Challa went to the graveyard. The deck rebuilt; Akroma's Will resolved after blockers, and two Angel tokens each dealt damage in both first-strike and normal combat steps, eliminating the last opponent. Installed won in 48117 ms; before lost in 31295 ms. This demonstrates effective double strike for the army, not commander survival or proof that flying bypassed blockers in that final combat.

Concrete mana limitation: before b3pod20-c4 recorded four land plays, all Plains, and never cast T'Challa; its last nonempty hand snapshot contained Beast Within. This supports a specific green-access/development problem, not a measured general color-screw rate. Both arms lost that trial. Other games failed to cast the commander despite recording both colors, so absence of a cast alone cannot diagnose mana failure.

Full-state capture was disabled. Exact available mana and payments, continuous commander survival, complete legal-blocking alternatives and reasons for holding cards are unavailable. Unblocked attacks alone do not establish a missed legal block. Equipment reassignment, commander prioritization and protection timing remain pilot limitations; card-conditioned outcomes are associations rather than individual causal effects.

The comparison remains between authorized modeled lists, including Divine Visitation in both and the disclosed assumed Mind's Eye cut for Forsaken Monument. It does not certify physical inventory or complete bracket legality. The supervisor checks structured reviewed:true and decision:continue before advancing. Retain the sleep/duration caveat and existing conservative scoring; no rerun is justified by these results.
